title: Communicate the Change: Efficient Expert Parallelism via Activation Compression
abstract: arXiv:2611.22215v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Scaling has driven the success of large language models (LLM), with sparse mixture-of-experts (MoE) architectures enabling greater parameter capacity without a proportional increase in computation. At large scales, MoE models rely on expert parallelism to distribute experts across devices. Each MoE layer requires two synchronous collective communication steps during inference: dispatching hidden states to the activated experts and combining the resulting expert outputs. As compute throughput has outpaced interconnect bandwidth, these synchronous collectives have become a major bottleneck to MoE scaling and efficiency. We address this challenge with EchoMoE, a lightweight architecture modification that retrofits existing MoE models, requiring approximately 8,500x fewer training tokens than full pretraining. Motivated by the observation that transformer blocks update the residual stream incrementally, we use a hidden state from an earlie

translated_title: 传递变化：通过激活压缩实现高效专家并行
translated_abstract: 规模化扩展推动了大语言模型（LLM）的成功，稀疏混合专家架构使模型能够获得更大的参数容量，而无需成比例地增加计算量。在大规模场景下，MoE 模型依赖专家并行将专家分布到多个设备上。每个 MoE 层在推理过程中需要两个同步的集合通信步骤：将隐藏状态分发到被激活的专家，以及合并各专家的输出结果。随着计算吞吐量的增长速度超过互连带宽的增长，这些同步集合通信已成为 MoE 扩展与效率的主要瓶颈。我们提出 EchoMoE 来应对这一挑战：这是一种轻量级的架构修改，可以改造现有的 MoE 模型，所需训练 token 数量约为完整预训练的 1/8500。受 transformer 块以增量方式更新残差流这一观察的启发，我们利用较早的隐藏状态……（原文摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: EchoMoE 利用 transformer 残差流以增量方式更新的特性，通过激活压缩只传递变化量而非完整隐藏状态，从而大幅降低专家并行中的同步集合通信瓶颈，且改造现有 MoE 模型仅需约完整预训练 1/8500 的训练 token。
en_tdlr: EchoMoE exploits the incremental nature of transformer residual stream updates to compress activations—communicating only the changes rather than full hidden states—retrofitting existing MoE models with roughly 8,500x fewer training tokens than full pretraining to drastically reduce the synchronous collective communication bottleneck in expert parallelism.
